description: Next earnings dates for held/wheel symbols, pulled from the Robinhood MCP earnings calendar during /refresh (see docs/ROBINHOOD_MCP_SYNC.md). The v6 action-queue engine annotates every item whose symbol reports within the lookahead window — earnings inflate option premium and IV crushes after the call, so entry/roll timing decisions need this in view. 'verified' = company-confirmed date vs estimate.
